content.text: I have enough to conclude. No non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-raiding covenant exists anywhere in the document.

input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-raiding covenant binding the Client. Searches for "solicit", "employ", "hire", "induce", "personnel" and "employee" return only unrelated provisions: the sole "unsolicited" hits are the Section 7 commercial e-mail/spam restrictions (p0048-p0049), and the "employee" hits are the Section 8(c) access-restriction covenant (p0053) and the Section 12 indemnity beneficiary lists (p0071-p0073). The Client covenants in Section 8 (compliance with laws, notification, limitation on access, credit data license, content representations, spamming) and the Section 10 confidentiality provisions contain no restriction on hiring or soliciting TrueLink personnel, and the only cross-referenced side agreement (the Non-Competition Agreement, cited at p0054) is invoked solely as a limit on the use of Credit Data. This matches the playbook preferred position of no non-solicit on the Customer, so no redline is warranted. Nothing to flag — the absence of a restrictive covenant here benefits our party.
